I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this channel. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with totes stacked beside door 4 at Southgate dispatch. Her 18:43 note closing the incident says Southgate cleared the backlog. Her first post says "depots," plural, but Southgate is the only one named.

I couldn't find a street address or site code for Southgate in anything Tobias can see, and there are no Tansley account files in the share. I suggested he ask Priyanka if the customer needs the full address.
